Class Organism

java.lang.Object
Sprite
Pixie
Organism
Direct Known Subclasses:
Predator
public class Organism extends Pixie
Autonomous prey agent with hunger, lifespan, reproduction, and a fleeing AI.

Each tick updateLogic(List, List) asks brain for a State, then wanders, flees, or eats. Offspring are staged into a spawn queue; death is flagged via dead so the world can remove the organism after the frame. Predator subclasses this type and replaces hunting and movement behavior.

  • Method Details

    • updateLogic

      public void updateLogic(List<Organism> worldEntities, List<Organism> spawnQueue)
      Advances one simulation tick: reproduction, death, AI, movement, and cooldowns.

      Fleeing occasionally spends hunger to raise speed; otherwise speed returns to the prey default of 1.55.

      Parameters:
      worldEntities - living organisms used by the brain for vision checks
      spawnQueue - list that receives newly created children this tick

    • die

      public void die()
      Marks this organism dead and updates largestGeneration if needed.

    • isDead

      public boolean isDead()
      Reports whether this organism has been marked for removal.
      Returns:
      true if die() has been called

    • processMovement

      private void processMovement()
      Walks toward currentTarget, pulling the next queued waypoint when needed.

      Targets outside the window are discarded. Arrival snaps to the waypoint; otherwise position advances by speed along the line to the target.

    • tryToDie

      public void tryToDie()
      Applies old-age death at deathFrame, or a rare random hazard death.

    • decreaseHunger

      protected void decreaseHunger()
      Occasionally reduces hunger while not digesting; starvation calls die().

      Currently invoked by Predator.updateLogic(List, List); prey metabolism is commented out in updateLogic(List, List).

    • getChildPossiblility

      private int getChildPossiblility()
      Population used as the denominator for prey birth chance; never returns zero.
      Returns:
      current prey census, or 1 if the census is empty

    • tryForChild

      public void tryForChild(List<Organism> spawnQueue)
      Attempts to spawn a child when hunger is high and the reproduction cooldown is finished.

      Birth probability is 1 / getChildPossiblility(), which scales inversely with the global prey count. A successful birth costs 80 hunger.

      Parameters:
      spawnQueue - list that receives the child if one is created

    • eat

      public void eat()
      Chance-based flora feeding that raises hunger by 5.08, capped at 100.

      Has no effect while digesting is greater than zero.

    • flee

      public void flee()
      Sets a single escape waypoint away from the closest known predator.

      Does nothing if no predator is cached or a target is already in progress, preventing a flood of waypoints each tick.
